gate_name: C16 Forensic Validity Audit and Next-Replicate Gate

classification_justification.technical_execution: VALID. The training job executed to completion on a genuine Kaggle GPU runtime. The ResNet18-UNet architecture (14,310,860 parameters), AdamW optimizer, Candidate F sampler, and data preprocessing were executed deterministically and reproduced bit-for-bit locally.
classification_justification.dataset_integrity: VALID. 100% of the 212 image and mask SHA-256 hashes were verified prior to training. Zero partition leakage occurred. HOLDOUT was strictly quarantined (access count = 0).
protocol_limitations: The C15 freeze specification contained a documentation defect (41 DEV / 39 HOLDOUT) which was manually corrected to (40 DEV / 40 HOLDOUT) during C16 pre-transfer verification without a formal incident log or amendment task.
C16 reported execution on a 'dual-T4 environment' but training executed on a single GPU (cuda:0); multi-GPU parallelism was not implemented.
The reported 55.5 MB VRAM was warmup eval memory, not peak training VRAM.

The 4.94% DEV mIoU is a genuine mathematical result on the OPS-02 dataset, but is non-comparable to the ~40.6% C8/C10 baselines due to complete datatake/scene independence and extreme DEV class sparsity.

blocking_issues_for_future_replicates.description: Formalize the C15->C16 freeze specification correction via an authoritative amendment artifact cryptographically binding all 3 manifests.
blocking_issues_for_future_replicates.remediation: Embed the SHA-256 hashes of physical, partition, and parent manifests directly into the freeze spec.

blocking_issues_for_future_replicates.description: Enforce strict single-GPU vs multi-GPU reporting accuracy and peak training memory measurement.
blocking_issues_for_future_replicates.remediation: Record torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() during training epoch rather than eval warmup.

blocking_issues_for_future_replicates.description: Macro mIoU is collapsed by zero-support and ultra-sparse phenomena (HM has 117 pixels on DEV; AF and RF have zero detected TP).
blocking_issues_for_future_replicates.remediation: Formulate a partitioned reporting protocol separating well-supported oceanic phenomena (MCC, IWs, BS) from sparse classes (HM, OF, RF).
